current_caption: Breast spatial coordinates and matched representations. Row (a) shows full tissue and row (b) a median-centered ROI with fixed 22\% half-extent, chosen without labels or scores. Columns show measured spot locations, the dominant Xenium-derived reference, PCA50 and Tessera (seed 1). All panels are author-generated coordinate maps; no source histology image is reproduced. Matching excludes reference categories below 1\% object prevalence; rare reference labels, unknowns and unmatched clusters are gray. ARI badges retain all valid classes and are three-seed means. Scale bars use source calibration.
